strategies.strategyName: Mega Rayquaza or Mega Mewtwo Recycle
strategies.text:
Overview:

Estimated Time to Win: [220s - 265s]

This strategy revolves around recycling powerful Mega Pokemon to defeat Mega Blaziken. This is mostly an easy strategy with only a few curve balls thrown in depending on Mega Blaziken's moveset. Overall, Mega Rayquaza & Mewtwo's typing are a strong advantage resisting fire & fighting moves with the latter resisting fighting only.


Basic Strategy:

  1. Create a battle party with only the respective Mega or Primal.
  2. DPS with Mega Ray's Dragon Ascent, Mega Mewtwo's Psystrike or optionally Primal Groudon's Precipice Blades.
  3. If a heavy charge move (Focus Blast, Overheat) is being used, the player can optionally dodge. Simply swipe left or right when the text appears. Note: Dodges cannot be inputted in the middle of an attack animation
  4. When the Mega is too low to continue, exit the lobby, heal and rejoin.


vs Brave Bird:

Mega Blaziken also learns Brave Bird (130dmg | 2.0s AD), a very powerful and fast charge move. Brave Bird's advantage is both its high damage and speed; outspeeding Dragon Ascent by 1.5s and Psystrike by 0.5s while also hitting Mega Mewtwo X for super effective damage.

  1. Dodging prior to Brave Bird is recommended.
  2. Opting for additional counters such as: Shadow Mewtwo, Shadow Groudon, Shadow Garchomp, Landorus Therian, etc.

vods.label: TTW: 204s (Lv 50 Mega Ray DPS, Focus Blast, 4 Rejoins)
TTW: 195s (Lv 52 Mewtwo Y Dodge, Focus Blast, 2 Rejoins)
